# ZXing JavaScript

Unmodified `third_party/zxing-js.umd.js` shipped with the installed Homeland-saas `html5-qrcode` 2.3.8 dependency, renamed to `.cjs` for Vite. Upstream: https://github.com/zxing-js/library

Apache-2.0 license included. Used as a second decoder for photographed identity cards; lazy-loaded only during QR scanning. Decoding stays on the device.
